commits.message:
Refactor and update templating and testing methods

Reformatted TemplatedDocument constructor for readability.
Updated CreatTemplatedDocumentAndNameValuePairs method:
  - Create key-value pairs array.
  - Use StringBuilder for TemplateBuilder.
  - Convert TemplateBuilder to TemplatedDocument.
  - Replace variables in TemplatedDocument.
  - Generate document from TemplatedDocument.
Updated String_MergeTemplateWithNamedValuePairsIntoADocumentAndOptionalyTest method:
  - Use Document property of TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs.
  - Return text variable.
Added System.Diagnostics to TemplateBuilderTest.
Updated Merge_A_Test_Template_With_Test_KeyValuePairs_Into_0000001_A_Test_Document_In_Order_To_Warmup_UnitTest method:
  - Merge template with key-value pairs and convert to document.
  - Print document using Debug.Print.

Remove ITemplatedDocument.Clone and update document handling

The `Clone` method has been removed from the `ITemplatedDocument` interface and its implementations. The `TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs` class now uses a `string` property named `Document` instead of the `ITemplatedDocument` interface.

Updated `StringBuilder_MergeTemplateWithNamedValuePairsIntoADocumentAndOptionalyTest` and `String_MergeTemplateWithNamedValuePairsIntoADocumentAndOptionalyTest` methods to work with the `Document` string property.

The `TemplateBuilder_MergeTemplateWithNamedValuePairsIntoADocumentAndOptionalyTest` method now creates a new `ITemplateBuilder` from the `Document` string and converts it back to an `ITemplatedDocument`.

The `UnitTestRoutines` class has been updated to use the `Document` string property.

Added a new private static stack `preBuiltTemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs` and `StackDepth` constant to the `PreBuiltTestTemplates` class.

Updated `Merge_A_Test_Template_With_Test_KeyValuePairs_Into_0000001_A_Test_Document_In_Order_To_Warmup_UnitTest` method in `StringBuilderTest` to reflect changes in the `StringBuilder_MergeTemplateWithNamedValuePairsIntoADocumentAndOptionalyTest` method.

Refactor: Move and rename classes for better organization

Moved FromToRange, PreBuiltTestTemplates, and TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs classes from Library to Models. Renamed and moved StringMergeAndTest, StringBuilderMergeAndTest, and TemplateBuilderMergeAndTest classes to UnitTests\Extentions. Updated project file paths and re-added files in new locations.

Refactor to use stack for managing template instances

Refactored `PreBuiltTestTemplates` to use a stack for managing
`TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs` instances instead of a single
static instance. This includes adding a stack with a predefined
depth, initializing it in a static constructor, and providing a
method to pop instances from the stack.

Updated `TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs` to include a new
constructor and modified the `Clone` method to use this constructor.

Modified `UnitTestRoutines`, `StringBuilderTest`, `StringTest`,
and `TemplateBuilderTest` to use the new stack-based method for
retrieving template instances.

Add Clone methods; refactor and update tests

- Added a `Clone` method to `ITemplatedDocument` and `TemplatedDocument`.
- Updated `TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs` with a `Clone` method.
- Refactored `CreatTemplatedDocumentAndNameValuePairs` for readability.
- Moved test files to `UnitTests` directory in project file.
- Updated test files to use `Clone` method for fresh test instances.
- Removed old test files and commented-out `UnitTestSmoke.cs`.

Refactor and update template merging tests

Removed redundant test files: StringBuilderTest.cs, StringTest.cs, TemplateBuilderTest.cs, UnitTestSmoke.cs. Updated TemplateBuilder.UnitTestProject.SharedProject.projitems to reflect these changes and reorganize references.

Re-added and updated several files with enhanced logic for merging templates with key-value pairs: StringBuilderMergeAndTest.cs, StringMergeAndTest.cs, TemplateBuilderMergeAndTest.cs, TemplatedDocumentAndKeyValuePairs.cs, UnitTestRoutines.cs.

Changed target framework in TemplateBuilder.csproj to netstandard2.1 and included symbols. Introduced new unit tests for StringBuilderTest, StringTest, and TemplateBuilderTest classes using MSTest framework, covering various document sizes.

Update target framework, packages, and remove class diagram

Updated `TemplateBuilder.UnitTestProject.csproj` to target `net9.0`.
Upgraded package references:
- `FluentAssertions` from `5.9.0` to `7.0.0`
- `Microsoft.NET.Test.Sdk` from `16.4.0` to `17.12.0`
- `MSTest.TestAdapter` from `2.0.0` to `3.7.0`
- `MSTest.TestFramework` from `2.0.0` to `3.7.0`
- `coverlet.collector` from `1.1.0` to `6.0.3`

Removed `ClassDiagram.cd` containing XML representation of class diagram.

Update solution for VS 17; modify project files

Updated TemplateBuilder.sln for Visual Studio 17 compatibility. Removed and re-added SharedMSBuildProjectFiles with new entries. Removed <PackageLicenseFile> and related <ItemGroup> from TemplateBuilder.csproj. Also removed import for TemplateBuilder.SharedProject.projitems.
